hypothesis: Candidate-dependent nearest-five truncation can introduce value-level context shifts unrelated to the physical effect of an action. Subtracting a same-current-state value with that candidate's exact human subset can improve action ranking and navigation beyond merely holding the root subset fixed.
module: Only the80-action next-value computation in the research wrapper. Original nearest-five actual history, GRU/spatial/head weights, rewards, terminal precedence, safety/risk masks and fixed8 MPPI remain unchanged.
fixed: Ordinary common-context control: the five nearest humans at the actual root supply every successor token, propagated by the same CV and sorted by the original builder. Histories are unchanged.
matched: For each action a retain its original successor-specific nearest-five identities S_a. Build a current-time history ending in a current-state token restricted to the same identities; evaluate b_a. Build b_0 with original current nearest-five identities. Replace nonterminal next V_a by V_a-(b_a-b_0), then use the unchanged terminal-aware r+gamma*V scoring and masks. If S_a=S_0, set the correction exactly zero. No correction for terminal rewards. This is a heuristic context-offset cancellation, NOT an unbiased policy gradient baseline, reward change or certified true Bellman value.
information: Observable current human positions/velocities/radii only, no goal/future/hidden controller state. Candidate subsets come from CV propagation already used by Parent. Five humans per token and original34 fields preserved, no larger observation vector.
compute: Every new arm computes both fixed and matched value batches at identical work; no training/fitting or threshold tuning. Historical original outcomes reused only after bitwise reference parity; original decision time remains a historical measurement, not simultaneous matched compute.
controls: Six complete native case121 episodes. Uncorrected wrapped decomposition must match original values/scores/actions exactly. N<=5 matched and fixed values must be original exactly. Terminal candidates must retain original Q/rewards. All commands/safety/rewards unchanged. Exact duplicate. Correction permitted only for changed subsets. Require changed support in at least1% of decisions and at least2 scenes, with actual ranking changes, else KILL inactive premise.

development.scope: Already used development cohort, never confirmation; no replacement cases.

go: No success/contact/collision regression against ANY control; >=2 additional successes versus EVERY control OR >=5% faster jointly successful time versus EVERY control; actual executed action differences and mean decision<250ms. Fresh confirmation only after credible incremental-capability review; paper PASS requires fresh paired intervals and meaningful additional mechanism beyond known context/advantage operations.
kill: Inactive subset/ranking mechanism, activated correction without registered independent task/safety/compute benefit, or fixed-root support absorbs it. No reweighting/correction scaling/training/human-count rescue. Preserve all negatives and choose a genuinely distinct hypothesis.
common: Frozen corrected GRU seed61,2000RL,80 native actions,50s,dt0.25,original reward,T24legal-prefix,nearest-five actual history,all-human safety,margin0.2/risk0.8/smoothing0.3,original fixed8MPPI. No4090, no new Parent/old Bayes/recovery training.
limitations: Context offsets may contain legitimate information, subtraction can harm. Current-context windows have the true historical length rather than duplicating a frame. This changes deployment scoring, not the training target; no claim of exact policy value or causal upstream training root. Standard baseline subtraction alone is not novelty. Negative result rejects this frozen correction only. Fresh cases remain unused unless all gates pass.
